descriptions.value: The Okta RADIUS Agent does not validate the sub-attribute length when parsing a Vendor-Specific attribute. A sub-attribute length of zero causes the parser to loop indefinitely, resulting in worker-thread exhaustion and denial of new RADIUS authentication requests.

descriptions.description: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')

assertions.title: Denial of Service in Okta RADIUS Agent Packet Parser

title: Denial of Service in Okta RADIUS Agent Packet Parser
